title: The Throw-In — EN/IT/DE (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational absurdist 100bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian German language learning trilingual football
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The throw-in is the most underrated moment in football
It happens approximately forty times a game
Everyone treats it as an inconvenience

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Ma il sacco laterale è una ripresa [But the throw-in is a restart]
Un piccolo ricominciamento [A tiny restart]
Un momento in cui il possesso è assegnato dalla geografia [A moment where possession is assigned by geography]
Non dal merito [Not by merit]
Il pallone è uscito vicino a te [The ball went out near you]
Quindi ora è tuo [So now it is yours]

[Chorus — English]
The throw-in says — here you go, your turn
Both feet on the ground, both hands on the ball
The throw-in is very specific about the feet

[Bridge — Deutsch]
Der Einwurfspezialist ist ein Mythos [The throw-in specialist is a myth]
Jede Mannschaft hat einen Spieler der die langen Einwürfe bekommt [Every team has one player who gets given the long throws]
Einen Spieler der nach dem Training auf dem Parkplatz geübt hat [One player who practised in the car park after training]
Einen Spieler der den Fünfmeterraum von der Seitenlinie aus erreichen kann [One player who can reach the six-yard box from the touchline]
Und diese Fähigkeit mit der Begeisterung einer Person einsetzt [And uses this ability with the enthusiasm of a person]
Die endlich ihren Zweck gefunden hat [Who has finally found their purpose]

[Verse 3 — English]
Football begins again from almost nothing — as it always has

[Outro — EN/IT/DE]
The throw-in
La rimessa laterale [The throw-in]
Der Einwurf [The throw-in]
That's my boy
